company.name: Landeed
company.shortDescription: Landeed is a prop-tech startup that offers a property title search engine for real estate owners, agents, developers, and legal advisors.
company.description:
Landeed is a proptech startup that develops a property title search engine for Indian real estate. The startup provides a simple and secure method of obtaining your Encumbrance Certificate. The Encumbrance Certificate is used to demonstrate that the property has a clear and marketable title and is free of any economic or legal liabilities. They also offer the quickest way to extract the Records of Rights (RoR), an important document kept by the state Revenue Department. Landeed's app provides instant access to the extent, ownership, and classification of land.

Landeed was founded in 2022 and is based in Benglauru, India.
